T: Kiss the cook. Spare the crab.
D: A young mermaid trades her voice for legs to win a prince.
P: Serve the mains when Chef Louis starts chasing Sebastian around the kitchen.
S: Garlic parsley butter baguette baked in foil, cut in chunks with a fork stuck in
Baguette split, spread with garlic and herb butter, baked at 200C for 12 minutes, served with forks stuck in for combing, or eating.
Ariel's grotto, Sebastian safely off the menu

Poached prawns piled over crisp iceberg and avocado with a pink Marie Rose sauce, lemon and a sprinkle of paprika, served in glass cups. Poach 500g green prawns in simmering salted water for 2 minutes, plunge into iced water, then peel. Mix 120g mayonnaise, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp Worcestershire, a squeeze of lemon and a dash of hot sauce. Shred half an iceberg and dice 1 avocado into 4 glasses. Pile on the prawns, spoon over the sauce and dust with paprika. Serve with lemon wedges.
Pasta shells with peas, cherry tomatoes, basil and lemon, served cold
Small pasta shells cooked al dente, tossed with peas, cherry tomatoes, basil and lemon dressing.
M: Eric's castle chicken with tarragon cream
Seared chicken breast in a shallot, lemon and tarragon cream sauce

Pan-roasted chicken breasts with a lemon, tarragon and cream sauce, buttered new potatoes and green beans, crab left firmly off the menu. Season 4 chicken breasts and sear in oil for 4 minutes a side, then finish in a 200C oven for 10 minutes and rest. In the same pan cook 1 chopped shallot in 20g butter, add 150ml chicken stock and the juice of half a lemon and reduce by half. Add 200ml cream and chopped tarragon and simmer 2 minutes. Boil 800g new potatoes and toss in butter. Steam 300g green beans.
Chef Louis's kitchen, fish only, no crab

Snapper fillets dusted in flour and pan-fried until the skin crackles, finished in nutty brown butter with lemon, capers and parsley, with crushed potatoes. Boil 800g baby potatoes until tender, crush lightly with olive oil and salt. Pat 4 snapper fillets dry, season and dust the flesh in flour. Fry skin side down in 2 tbsp oil for 4 minutes until crisp, flip for 1 minute and lift out. Add 60g butter to the pan and cook until nut brown, then add 1 tbsp capers, the juice of 1 lemon and chopped parsley. Spoon over the fish.
W: Blue jelly with gummy fish, whipped cream, shortbread sand, white chocolate shell
Blue jelly set in clear glasses with gummy fish suspended halfway, topped with whipped cream and crushed shortbread for sand, a white chocolate shell on the side.
K: Pineapple juice, coconut water and lemonade with a splash of blue curaçao syrup
Pineapple juice, coconut water and lemonade with a splash of blue curaçao syrup, over ice.

steps.text: Mash the butter with crushed garlic and chopped parsley.
Split the baguette, spread, and wrap in foil.
Bake at 200C, then cut into chunks and stick a fork in each.
Cook the pasta shells al dente, drain and cool.
Blanch the peas and halve the tomatoes.
Toss everything with torn basil, lemon juice and olive oil. Season and serve cold.

Sear the mushrooms cut side down in oil, then finish in a 200C oven for 10 minutes.
In the same pan cook the shallot in some of the butter, add the stock and lemon juice and reduce by half.
Add the cream and tarragon and simmer.
Boil the potatoes and toss in the rest of the butter. Steam the beans.

ingredients.item: blue food colouring, a few drops

steps.text: Whisk the apple juice, sugar and agar in a saucepan, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring. Tint blue with the food colouring.
Pour half into four glasses and leave for about 15 minutes until just set. Keep the rest warm.
Push the gummy fish into the jelly, pour over the rest and chill until firm.
Whip the cream and crush the shortbread.
Top with cream, shortbread for sand and a shell shaved from the white chocolate.

steps.text: Mix the pineapple juice and coconut water in a jug with ice.
Top with lemonade and swirl in the curaçao syrup. Pour into four glasses.

s.note: Garlic parsley butter baguette baked in foil, cut in chunks with a fork stuck in
s.how: Mash 100g butter with 3 crushed garlic cloves and parsley. Split a baguette, spread, wrap in foil and bake at 200C for 12 minutes. Cut into chunks and stick a fork in each, for combing or eating.

s.note: Pasta shells with peas, cherry tomatoes, basil and lemon, served cold
s.how: Cook 250g pasta shells al dente and cool. Toss with 150g blanched peas, 250g halved cherry tomatoes, torn basil, the juice of a lemon and 3 tbsp olive oil. Season and serve cold.

m.n: Eric's castle chicken with tarragon cream
m.note: Seared chicken breast in a shallot, lemon and tarragon cream sauce
m.how: Season 4 chicken breasts and sear in oil for 4 minutes a side, then finish in a 200C oven for 10 minutes and rest. In the same pan cook 1 chopped shallot in 20g butter, add 150ml chicken stock and the juice of half a lemon and reduce by half. Add 200ml cream and chopped tarragon and simmer 2 minutes. Boil 800g new potatoes and toss in butter. Steam 300g green beans.

w.note: Blue jelly with gummy fish, whipped cream, shortbread sand, white chocolate shell
w.how: Make 2 packets blue jelly and pour halfway into 4 glasses. Chill until just setting, push in gummy fish, add the rest and set. Top with whipped cream, crushed shortbread for sand and a white chocolate shell.

d.note: Pineapple juice, coconut water and lemonade with a splash of blue curaçao syrup
d.how: Mix 500ml pineapple juice and 500ml coconut water in a jug with ice. Top with 500ml lemonade and swirl in 2 tbsp blue curaçao syrup. Pour into four glasses.
